name: notion
description: Notion (read only): search pages and databases, read a page or the rows of a database through an internal integration. Needs the integration secret; the pages must be shared with the integration.

tools.name: notion_check_connection
tools.description: Check the Notion connection (token) and show the integration and workspace.

tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Search the pages and databases that are shared with the integration, newest edit first. Read only.

tools.name: notion_read_page
tools.description: Read one page: title, properties and the text of its blocks. Read only.

tools.name: notion_query_database
tools.description: Read the rows of a database with their properties (first rows, no filter). Read only.

notion_token.title: Integration secret
notion_token.description: notion.so/profile/integrations, New integration (internal), copy the secret. Then share each page or database with it (page menu, Connections). Stored as a secret. Read access is enough.
